# Representative HVSC DMC tunes for the clusters the generalised recogniser now
# handles.  Format: "<byte_exact> <HVSC relative path>" (paths only; HVSC works
# are copyright, never committed).  byte_exact=1 => init-$37 generation the
# player reproduces byte-exact (verified against the py65 register oracle);
# byte_exact=0 => a later generation (init-$1d) that is recognised + parsed but
# not yet played byte-exact.  Resolved under $HVSC; skips cleanly when unset.
#
# 2-entry (init/play) dispatch, identical $37 body -- sidid $37/$85 cluster:
1 MUSICIANS/B/Bart/Summertime.sid
1 MUSICIANS/B/Bart/Cuba_Libre.sid
1 MUSICIANS/B/Bart/Oldline3.sid
# 2-entry dispatch, identical body, init entry $39 -- sidid $39/$85 cluster:
1 MUSICIANS/D/Doxx/Hendrix_Live.sid
1 MUSICIANS/D/Doxx/Nuclear_Disaster.sid
1 MUSICIANS/D/Doxx/Skyhigh_Tune.sid
# Relocated $37-generation builds (load != $1000): byte-exact after the
# absolute-operand fix (previously mis-played):
1 GAMES/A-F/Brutally_Brainstorm.sid
1 MUSICIANS/R/Robric/Action_Tank_2.sid
# Later generation (init-$1d, markers $7e/$7d/$7f): recognised, not byte-exact:
0 MUSICIANS/B/Bakker_Nantco/Glorious.sid
0 MUSICIANS/B/Bayliss_Richard/Rocket_n_Roll.sid
